title: In the Narrow Places; Daily Inspiration for the Three Weeks
originalTitle: בין המצרים; השראה יומית לשלשת השבועות
attributionNote: Authorship follows the Sefaria catalogue record for this work. Where a text is traditionally attributed or collectively compiled, the library does not assert a single author beyond the source's own metadata.
description: 21st-century work by Dr. Erica Brown with short essays and prompts for reflection for each day of the period from the 17th of Tammuz through Tisha B’Av. Complete Jewish Thought text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Jewish philosophy and theology argue about God, revelation, law and the human good. These works belong to their own schools and arguments; the library does not flatten them into a single Jewish doctrine.
availabilityNote: Imported from Sefaria. Version, source and licence are recorded per edition.
